acceptance: all scheduled IDs reconcile exactly once; hashes and clock fields valid
generator completes full physical horizon and exits0 with zero restarts/OOM
application lifecycle, Service/endpoints, API and node/resource observations are captured independently
Service DNS resolves to recorded ClusterIP; no forwarding process in any request path
no unexplained missing request measurements; host observer pause does not interrupt durable generator stream
request/application/transport errors and timeouts remain explicit outcomes; zero application failures is NOT required
host power/continuity guards valid and >=20GiB reserve preserved
original source/scientific evidence unchanged; all three conditions required; no automatic retry after a loaded condition failure

comparability.controller_and_profile_science: unchanged; no compression or altered checkpoints/targets/seeds
comparability.path: changed: host/port-forward path removed; DNS/Service path included

generator.image: same pinned workload image, imagePullPolicy Never
generator.on_collection_failure: preserve cluster/node path and recovery config; retry export only, never replay requests
generator.persistence: exclusive OWNER; per-row flush+fsync; atomic fsynced START/DONE; node hostPath survives Pod termination
generator.resource_basis: fixed engineering budget for <=32 concurrent network/file writers and 12 RPS, chosen before qualification; no policy/outcome tuning
generator.retrieval: sealed byte-copy from node filesystem via Docker control API; separate from Service request path; verify SHA/counts before deleting cluster
generator.timeout_semantics: same 5-second blocking-socket I/O timeout as original urllib; not a newly fabricated total wall-time completion cap
generator.traffic: Pod -> application Service DNS/ClusterIP -> application Pod

measurement.classification: HTTP/body errors vs explicit connection/body transport errors vs connection deadlines vs response deadlines with unresolved cause; no transport error relabelled as intrinsic application failure
measurement.clock: local generator monotonic durations; original wall/monotonic pairs and boot/time namespace retained; host telemetry receipt/admission clock protocol unchanged
measurement.failure_aggregate: legacy application_failures numerical field remains total failed client attempts; no application-cause interpretation; failed_attempts explicit alias and disaggregated errors supplied
measurement.p95: numpy default 0.95 quantile of successful scheduled-offer latencies
measurement.primary_latency: scheduled offer -> completion in generator local monotonic time; includes scheduling delay
measurement.request_identity: every scheduled offer has exactly one result, including unsent concurrency-cap drops
measurement.slo: all failed offered attempts plus successful scheduled-offer latencies >0.25 s, divided by all offers
measurement.throughput: successful completions within fixed window divided by physical window seconds; warmup-origin offers excluded
measurement.window: request offsets [start,end); full30m primary, first5m and remaining25m descriptive

qualification_scope: DIAGNOSTIC_NON_CLAIM only; short450/450s phase-transition diagnostic is not a changed/compressed claim treatment; real claim phases remain900/900s
